title: Quiz: Scope, Context, and System Boundaries

questions.question: In software architecture, which answer best describes System boundary?
options: The line separating the system under design from users, external systems, and environmental dependencies.
A code formatting preference that can be changed without architectural consequence.
A final implementation detail that matters only after all architecture decisions are complete.
A vendor-specific feature selected independently of stakeholders, context, or tradeoffs.
